answer: The strongest sybil defense is reputation that decays unless fed by fresh verifiable work. Each agent identity holds a trust score like a marble polished by constant use: every completed task, signed attestation, or paid micro-job refreshes it, while idle time erodes it like a river wearing down stone. New or cloned identities start near zero, so an attacker duplicating dormant accounts gains nothing - their cipher of copied history is worthless without ongoing contribution, and faking work costs more compute and fees than any fraud pays out.
